argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$path='E:\ChatGPT-Security-Audit\FilesCom\capture-pack\01_site_overview'
if (!(Test-Path $path)) { throw "Folder not found: $path" }
Write-Output '=== FILES ==='
Get-ChildItem $path -Force | Sort-Object LastWriteTime |
  Select-Object Name,FullName,Length,LastWriteTime,Extension | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Output '=== HASHES ==='
Get-ChildItem $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 | Sort-Object Path | Format-Table -AutoSize

note: Inspect Files.com capture-pack 01_site_overview folder for user-provided evidence
